notes: Fixed the Scene Editor / Timeline mapping (it was inverted). Timeline is now the full editor — content rail + preview + inspector + the timeline along the bottom — and stays the default landing. Scene Editor is the previous view: your scene cards stacked above (each editable), with the timeline dock at the bottom. The top-bar toggle (and the matching one in the Scene Editor header, relabelled to match) now switches between these two view modes; the in-editor sub-layout that hid the panels has been removed. The CapCut-style block separation in the timeline is kept.
